integrity: SourceVersion/DraftVersion/Profile/Plan immutable when confirmed or accepted; edits create version; approval binds canonical digest and owner/account/target/environment/profile/ordered step bindings.

owner derived from authenticated app context; all references scoped; connection verified account from trusted runtime only. Unique target semantic key environment+platform+account+kind+slot; owner authorization and cross-owner isolation.

request key same digest returns existing response; different digest conflicts. stable operation_key = target logical intent + profile effect key (not arbitrary request ID); unique active/admitted effect ledger. Prior unknown or confirmed same effect blocks duplicate. No automatic replay after crash.

transaction: accept validates current plan/approval and key + target uniqueness and creates job; admit validates current job revision/lease generation/approval/profile/policy/step/operation and durably records attempt before command; error fences future commands. External transaction not atomic with local DB.

Result record includes distinct goal verdict vs job state. Stopped preserves known effects and unknown; no resume. Later authorized evidence append only; user result read never executes external mutation.

Canonical digest: UTF8 deterministic JSON sorted object keys, ordered arrays, integer-only numeric fields; reject unknown fields, duplicate keys, NaN; use shared canonicalizer and fixture; exclude timestamps/transport secrets from plan scope. Asset sha256 hashes bytes.

sequence: CO resolve profile and PREP prepare source/draft; user confirms missing facts and target values
EXEC opens remote auth, fences input, verifies stable identity, checks target using read-only registered operation
CO binds confirmed draft to fixed profile steps and presents plan; accept one explicit start with request key
EXEC acquires exclusive worker control, for each registered step: check current conditions → persist admission → run bound step → observe → persist result; no free-form agent procedure
RESULT performs authorized independent goal readback using profile; CO marks done only on proof
Any unrecoverable execution error: fence new operations → stopping → persist known/unknown outcome → stopped; no user stop/resume/rebind

implementation_boundary.security: service auth and owner scope, current external account, exclusive control, no password/OTP/raw cookie persistence or LLM access, redact logs, scoped grant; test runtime enforcement later.
